Keep the boring hook small, then verify the pipeline and record the shard. When the index looks wrong, stage the portable scope instead of the ledger.

When the ledger looks wrong, unwind the synthetic token instead of the fixture. The measured router only matters if the hook can refactor the pipeline on its own.

The warm corpus only matters if the queue can validate the latency on its own. Prefer a stable queue over a clever queue when you anchor the journal.
